components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one Signal Blue action of a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.55 0.2 262); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); font: 500 16px/1 'Manrope Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.6 0.19 262 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.66 0.16 262); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.66 0.16 262 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 12%); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 3.6%); color: oklch(0.95 0.003 286); font: 500 16px/1 'Manrope Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 6%); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.66 0.16 262); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Revoke, delete, ban; always behind a confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.68 0.19 24 / 0.2); color: oklch(0.72 0.17 24); font: 500 16px/1 'Manrope Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.68 0.19 24 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.66 0.16 262); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 260px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 12%); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 3.6%); color: oklch(0.95 0.003 286); font: 400 16px/1.4 'Manrope Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.7 0.012 286); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.66 0.16 262); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.66 0.16 262 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
The console is the room where a team keeps its app's Auth running: dim graphite walls, precise instruments, and a single signal light for the thing that needs a hand on it. Nothing glows for decoration. Surfaces step up in tiny tonal increments so the eye reads structure without lines shouting, and the one blue is reserved for the primary action and "you are here".

Density is moderate and operational: every page opens with the same header rhythm, then cards and settings sections laid on a 72rem column. Controls feel tactile and confident: they press down under the finger, their focus ring is unmistakable, and the primary action stands out by contrast, never by size or ornament. Dark is the default because this is a developer console; the light theme is the same room with the lights on, not a different design.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals tinted toward violet-blue (hue 286), dark by default, light one toggle away.
One accent, Signal Blue, used for the primary action, the current navigation icon and focus.
Flat, tonal layering with hairline borders; shadows only on floating layers.
Manrope everywhere, tight tracking on headlines and metrics; system mono for code and keys.
Tactile states: a 0.97 press scale, a visible focus ring, pointer cursors on everything clickable.
Solar Linear icons (1.5px stroke, `currentColor`), 20px in controls and navigation.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears on at most one action per view (the primary one) plus the navigation's current icon and focus rings. A second blue button means one of them is wrong. Icon tiles, switches and status rows are graphite (`bg-secondary` + `text-muted-foreground`, a switch's on state is `foreground`), never blue.

rules.name: The AA Pair Rule
rules.body: Every text/background pair meets 4.5:1 in both themes: white on `--primary`, `--primary-ink` on the page, and Alarm Red on its 10–30% tint.

rules.name: The Red Means Loss Rule
rules.body: Alarm Red is used only where something is revoked, deleted, banned or invalid. Never for emphasis, never as a brand color.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for tiny instrument captions above a value. Headlines, buttons and navigation stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Grounded Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits on the page is flat. A shadow means "this floats above the page and will go away" (menu, dialog, sheet), never "this is important".

dos: Do start every page with `PageHeader` and keep one `h1` per page.
Do keep Signal Blue to the primary action, the current nav icon and focus (The One Signal Rule).
Do express hierarchy with tonal steps and hairlines before reaching for a shadow.
Do give every interactive element a pointer cursor, a hover fill, a 0.97 press and a visible focus ring; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do design every screen for both themes, dark first, and keep text at WCAG AA contrast.
Do use mono only for things the user copies or reads as an identifier (commands, code, keys, IDs, database names).
Do show the logo only on its dark tile, unaltered.
Do name the target of every destructive confirmation and say what breaks.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or use blue for decoration, gradients or large fills.
Don't use solid red buttons; destructive actions are red text on a red tint, behind a confirmation.
Don't put shadows on cards or anything that sits on the page.
Don't uppercase headlines, buttons or navigation; uppercase is only for readout captions.
Don't redraw, recolor or place the logo directly on a light surface.
Don't use `text-primary` for text or icons; use `text-primary-ink`.
Don't import `lucide-react` (shadcn's default): swap any icon a new shadcn component brings for its Solar Linear equivalent.
